windows.changelog:
- IMU calibration: set your sensor orientation for correctly aligned charts and FFT axes. 
 - Lap Manager: new laps library and downloadable online split catalog, with nearest-track ranking and automatic folder sync. 
 - New G-G diagram and Travel Budget dashboard card. 
 - Ride Harshness colour-by-slot/channel toggle and clearer comparison feedback. 
 - Various bug fixes and stability improvements.
